findings.title: The cycle-9 fix catches only FileNotFoundError; any other OSError on open(draft_path) (IsADirectoryError, PermissionError, symlink loop) crashes the check and hides every later draft's result line, which the cycle-9 ruling forbids.
findings.evidence: .claude/agents/idea-planner.md:197-202; agent-workflows/idea-planner-agent.md:186-191. Reproduced against the generated command: a directory at the draft path, a chmod 000 draft, and a self-referential symlink each produce a traceback, empty stdout and exit 1 while a valid PLAN-200 draft sorts later.
findings.consequence: A realistic leftover in docs/00-working/promoted/ silently suppresses conformance results for other tracks.
